covers: The command set of the uPD1990A and uPD4990A, selected by the C pins or the 4-bit serial command register when STB rises

entries.name: register hold
entries.description: Command 0: the shift register is held; the clock runs and test mode ends.
entries.behaviour: CLK does not shift while it is latched. DATA OUT toggles every half second (1 Hz pulse) and TP at 64 Hz with a 32768 Hz crystal, both starting at once. The clock is enabled and test mode is cleared.

entries.name: shift
entries.description: Command 1: CLK shifts the time register, least significant bit first.
entries.behaviour: Each rising CLK shifts the register one bit right, DATA IN entering at bit 7 of its last byte. The register is 5 bytes, or 6 on a 4990A in serial mode. The strobe puts bit 0 of byte 0 on DATA OUT, stops its pulse, and starts the clock unless in test mode.

entries.name: time set
entries.description: Command 2: copies the shift register into the time counter and sets the emulated date and time.
entries.behaviour: Bytes 0 to 4 (and 5, the year, in 4990A serial mode) load the counter; layout is under command 0x03. MAME disables the clock, but realigning its sub-second divider re-arms it in the same strobe, so the clock keeps running. DATA OUT shows bit 0 and stops pulsing; in test mode TP goes low and stops.

entries.name: time read
entries.description: Command 3: copies the time counter into the shift register to be shifted out.
entries.behaviour: Byte 0 seconds, 1 minutes, 2 hours, 3 day, all BCD; byte 4 high nibble month (binary 1 to 12), low nibble weekday minus 1; byte 5, 4990A serial mode only, BCD year. DATA OUT pulses at 1 Hz on a 4990A, 0.5 Hz on a 1990A (512 Hz in test mode); TP is 32 Hz in test mode.

entries.name: TP 64 Hz
entries.description: Command 4: TP becomes a 64 Hz square wave.
entries.behaviour: TP toggles at 64 Hz with a 32768 Hz crystal, starting at once. The clock is enabled and test mode ends.

entries.name: TP 256 Hz
entries.description: Command 5: TP becomes a 256 Hz square wave.
entries.behaviour: TP toggles at 256 Hz with a 32768 Hz crystal, starting at once. The clock is enabled and test mode ends.

entries.name: TP 2048 Hz
entries.description: Command 6: TP becomes a 2048 Hz square wave.
entries.behaviour: TP toggles at 2048 Hz with a 32768 Hz crystal, starting at once. The clock is enabled and test mode ends.

entries.name: TP 4096 Hz
entries.description: Command 7: TP becomes a 4096 Hz square wave; only reachable through the 4-bit serial command.
entries.behaviour: TP toggles at 4096 Hz with a 32768 Hz crystal. The C pins at 7 never give this: they mean test mode on a 1990A and the serial mode on a 4990A. The clock is enabled and test mode ends.

entries.name: TP 1 s interval
entries.description: Command 8: TP becomes a square wave with a 1 second period; serial command only.
entries.behaviour: TP toggles every half second with a 32768 Hz crystal, starting at once. The clock is enabled and test mode ends. MAME treats interval and pulse alike; the source marks the difference as unknown.

entries.name: TP 10 s interval
entries.description: Command 9: TP becomes a square wave with a 10 second period; serial command only.
entries.behaviour: TP toggles every 5 seconds with a 32768 Hz crystal, starting at once. The clock is enabled and test mode ends.

entries.name: TP 30 s interval
entries.description: Command 10: TP becomes a square wave with a 30 second period; serial command only.
entries.behaviour: TP toggles every 15 seconds with a 32768 Hz crystal, starting at once. The clock is enabled and test mode ends.

entries.name: TP 60 s interval
entries.description: Command 11: TP becomes a square wave with a 60 second period; serial command only.
entries.behaviour: TP toggles every 30 seconds with a 32768 Hz crystal, starting at once. The clock is enabled and test mode ends.

entries.name: INT reset output
entries.description: Command 12: interrupt output reset; serial command only and not emulated.
entries.behaviour: MAME does nothing for it beyond the effect shared by commands 4 to 14: the clock is enabled and test mode ends. The source marks it as to do.

entries.name: INT run clock
entries.description: Command 13: interrupt output, clock running; serial command only and not emulated.
entries.behaviour: MAME does nothing for it beyond the effect shared by commands 4 to 14: the clock is enabled and test mode ends. The source marks it as to do.

entries.name: INT stop clock
entries.description: Command 14: interrupt output, clock stopped; serial command only and not emulated.
entries.behaviour: MAME does nothing for it beyond the effect shared by commands 4 to 14, so the clock is enabled, not stopped, and test mode ends. The source marks it as to do.

entries.name: test mode
entries.description: Command 15: test mode, reached by the C pins at 7 on a 1990A or the 4-bit serial value 15.
entries.behaviour: Stops the clock and the data pulse and counts at 8192 Hz on a 4990A, 1024 Hz on a 1990A with a 32768 Hz crystal. With OE low each byte counts alone and DATA OUT goes high when any wraps; with OE high the bytes ripple. Command 0 or 4 to 14 leaves it; untested in the source.
